A Colibri Industries generator that burns Pyrolysis Gas to produce electricity.

Expands the use of pyrolysis products in Colibri Industries. The Colibri Generator burns pyrolysis gas to generate electricity, turning a byproduct of plastic-waste processing into a useful source of energy.
Processes plastic and coal into pyrolysis oil, pyrolysis gas, carbon residue, and carbon dioxide.
A thermal processing unit that converts Plastic Waste into pyrolysis oil, pyrolysis gas, and Carbon Residue for further industrial use.
An industrial crushing and screening unit that separates gravel from GSG and prepares Glass Feedstock for glass production.
A high-temperature unit that thermally processes Glass Feedstock and Recycled Plastic into molten materials for further production.
Unlocks Colibri Industries technologies for pyrolysis processing and the further use of pyrolysis products.
Unlocks Colibri Industries technologies for thermal processing of raw materials. Enables prepared glass feedstock and recycled plastic to be melted for further production.
Crushes and screens GSG to separate gravel from the sand-and-glass fraction, producing Glass Feedstock with a small loss of fine material.
The first step in Colibri Industries development. The kiln fires durable bricks from dirt and coal, providing the basic construction material required for subsequent facilities and technologies.
A compact industrial kiln that fires bricks from dirt using coal, supplying the basic construction material for further Colibri Industries development.
Fires dirt with coal to produce bricks.
Loose recycled plastic produced from shredded Plastic Waste and intended for further processing.
Molten plastic prepared for transport through molten channels and further industrial processing.
A Colibri Industries shredder that processes Plastic Waste into loose Recycled Plastic.
Shreds Plastic Waste into loose Recycled Plastic for further processing.
A Colibri Industries facility that processes molten materials into industrial products.
Processes Molten Plastic with water into Plastic while releasing depleted Waste Steam.
Unlocks the Colibri Polymer Plant for advanced polymer processing.
A deep-separation complex for Waste Slurry that recovers useful fractions and prepares the resulting materials for further processing.
A primary waste hydroprocessing unit that mixes waste with water and converts it into Waste Slurry for further separation and treatment.
An advanced hydroprocessor for larger waste volumes, providing Waste Slurry more efficiently to downstream recycling stages.
Waste Slurry is a suspension created by mixing solid waste with water. It is an intermediate product transported through pipes and processed further inside the recycling chain.
GSG — Gravel–Sand–Glass is a recovered heterogeneous mixture of gravel, sand, and crushed glass fragments that requires further processing and separation.
A prepared sand-and-glass fraction obtained by separating gravel from GSG. It is intended for further thermal processing in glass production.
Mixes waste with water to produce Waste Slurry.
Mixes pressed waste with water to produce Waste Slurry.
Separates Waste Slurry with gravel and sand into wastewater, sediment, biomass, Plastic Waste, and GSG.
Pre-sorts waste to recover recyclables, then mixes the remaining waste with water to produce Waste Slurry.
Tier II Waste Slurry from Pressed Waste
Processes pressed waste with water while recovering recyclables.
Advances Colibri Industries with a hydroprocessor that mixes waste with water to create Waste Slurry for further separation, treatment, and material recovery.
Expands the hydroprocessing capabilities of Colibri Industries. Unlocks additional methods of waste processing and improves waste-slurry production for subsequent processing stages.
Deepens Colibri Industries waste processing by separating Waste Slurry into useful fractions and returning recovered materials to the production cycle.

Brings Colibri Industries hydroprocessing to an industrial scale. Unlocks the Colibri Hydroprocessor II, an advanced facility for larger-scale and more efficient waste processing and waste-slurry preparation.
Melts Glass Feedstock using coal, producing molten glass with high exhaust emissions.
Melts Glass Feedstock using Carbon Residue for faster, more efficient production with lower exhaust emissions.
Improves Colibri Industries thermal-processing technologies, unlocking more efficient methods for melting glass and recycled plastic using carbon residue.
Melts Recycled Plastic using coal, producing Molten Plastic with higher exhaust and air-pollution emissions.
Melts Recycled Plastic using Carbon Residue, halving exhaust and air-pollution emissions compared with coal.
Burns pyrolysis gas to generate electricity while producing exhaust gases.
Processes molten glass into Glass and Broken Glass with intentional material loss.
Burns Pyrolysis Oil in the gas boiler to produce high-pressure steam and exhaust.
Burns Pyrolysis Gas in the gas boiler to produce high-pressure and depleted steam.
